bootstrap.contrast_method: paired seed-ID resampling of higher-population minus lower-population differences on common seeds
bootstrap.interpretation: With three canonical seeds, intervals are coarse descriptive uncertainty summaries and are not hypothesis tests.

metric_semantics.achievement_counts: Cumulative binary first-unlock types, not repeated completion events.
metric_semantics.cached_input_tokens: Provider-reported cached input-token subset of input_tokens.
metric_semantics.canonical_submitted_noops: canonical Noop passed to env.step after action validation
metric_semantics.delivered_bytes: Source worker_peer delivered fan-out bytes, not provider network bytes.
metric_semantics.effective_environment_noops: canonical submitted Noop, or any action masked to Noop because the worker was inactive in the pre-step observation
metric_semantics.executed_noops: Deprecated CSV compatibility alias for canonical_submitted_noops.
metric_semantics.inactive_billed_turns: Submitted model turns whose worker was inactive in the pre-step observation.
metric_semantics.recovered_transport_retry_count: A retryable provider transport error followed by one final completed logical response; equal to provider attempts minus logical responses.
metric_semantics.summed_model_latency_seconds: Sum of per-call latency; may exceed episode wall time when calls overlap.
metric_semantics.total_tokens: input_tokens + provider output_tokens; reasoning_tokens are a subset of output_tokens and are not added twice.

noop_reconstruction.unrecoverable_without_debug: For legacy episodes without a complete per-turn debug journal, corrected parse counts and effective-environment Noop causes are unavailable. action_frequency.Noop recovers canonical submitted Noops only; it must not be interpreted as effective environment execution.

turn_accounting.legacy_parse_override: When debug reconstruction is complete, action_parse_rate and its success/fail/skipped counts use corrected pre-step inactivity. The biased episode value is retained only as legacy_recorded_action_parse_rate.

semantics.canonical_submitted_noop: canonical Noop passed to env.step after action validation
semantics.effective_environment_noop: canonical submitted Noop, or any action masked to Noop because the worker was inactive in the pre-step observation
semantics.effective_noop_partition: intentional actionable + parse fallback + active action-validation fallback + inactive effective + active residual
